title: Later ENSET campus protest over release of a student imprisoned after Jan29 apprehension
notes: S034 is a Feb8 search-only article reporting a 48-hour ENS ultimatum after an ENS committee member was apprehended in Antananarivo Jan29 and later imprisoned in Antsiranana; it threatens a future demonstration but does not report one on Jan29 or Feb8. S019 is an opened Feb10 report saying ENSET students demonstrated again on campus after a short respite, demanding release of the peer and leading to three arrests; it does not state the gathering date, so February is the most precise supported onset. Relationship to the Jan25 E003 campus protest remains unresolved. Keep this as later-month follow-up and do not code the Jan29 apprehension as Jan25 protest response.

title: February medical-student protest over scholarships and internship allowances
notes: Feb13 report says event occurred Feb12; 2424 search snippet attributes a dispute over whether leaders intended to demonstrate and alleges infiltration. Similar grievance; continuity from Jan21 is not established.

title: February paramedical strike and gathering outside HJRA
notes: Feb8 2424 report says paramedical union members gathered outside HJRA, were prevented from entering by police, and announced a general strike over COVID requisition allowances/recruitment. This is outside January and does not establish that the Jan16 conditional threat was executed in January.

title: February Barikadimy/Toamasina student protest over scholarship and equipment arrears
notes: A separate Feb18 public protest at Barikadimy over four months of scholarships/equipment was reported, with a student killed, injuries and arrests. It belongs to February; similar university scholarship grievances do not establish continuous attendance or one event with January Ankatso/Antsiranana actions.

title: February opposition parliamentary-report meeting attempt in Antananarivo
notes: Feb20 opposition legislators planned a public report at Ambohijatovo; Anadolu says the venue was blocked, several small gatherings occurred nearby and at least ten people were arrested, without an attendance estimate. Separate February political attempt, unrelated to January student events; do not code as a January candidate.
